Liffeyside General Hospital - DEPARTMENT OF RADIOLOGY CHEST RADIOGRAPH PA AND LATERAL Accession no: XR/82/061/3390 Name: Oksana Havrylenko D.O.B.: 19.05.2061 Hosp no: LGH 20-448193 Sex: F Date of exam: 01/06/2082 08:55 Ward/Location: Maternity Ward 2, bed 11 Requested by: Dr E. Villaverde Mora (Cardiology) Reported by: Dr Anjali Deshpande-Kerr, Consultant Radiologist
CLINICAL DETAILS (as given on request): 21 year old, 34 weeks pregnant, severe pre-eclampsia admitted yesterday evening, dispnea and orthopnea since 2 days. Exclude pulmonary edema, cardiomegaly. Abdomen shielded.
TECHNIQUE: PA erect and lateral in the bed (patient could not stand well), low dose, lead shield apply on the abdomen.
COMPARISON: There is no previous chest imaging in our system. Patient say she had a chest film in Lviv, Ukraine in 2079 at her university medical check but is no possible to get.
FINDINGS: The heart size is in the normal limits (cardiothoracic ratio about 0.50, taking in account the AP projection and the pregnancy). The mediastinal contour is normal. No widened mediastinum. Lungs: mild perihilar haziness and Kerley B lines at both bases, in keeping with early interstitial pulmonary edema. No consolidation. Small bilateral pleural effusions, blunting of the costophrenic angles, right more than left. No pneumothorax. Bones: the left clavicle shows an old healed fracture with callus, mid shaft, no acute abnormality. (Matches history of clavicle fracture 09/2074 in the clinical notes.) Rest of visible skeleton normal. Upper abdomen: gas pattern normal. Lines: no lines or tubes.
IMPRESSION: 1. Early interstitial pulmonary edema with small bilateral effusions, heart size normal. This may be due to hypertensive disorder of the pregnancy, a cardiac cause is less likely but echocardiogram is suggested. 2. Old healed left clavicle fracture. 3. No pneumonia. No sign of Pott's or sarcoid disease.
Recommend: echocardiography, and repeat film after delivery and diuresis. Results phoned to Dr Villaverde at 09:40 on 01/06/2082 and to the ward sister Grace Day, who read back.
